pulses.name: New ransomware targets Turkey via Adwind RAT
pulses.description: A threat cluster has been identified leveraging a customized Adwind (Java RAT) variant with polymorphic characteristics to deliver JanaWare ransomware. pulses.name: A new Mac stealer targeting $10K+ crypto wallets

This Go-written modular stealer exclusively targets macOS users with cryptocurrency holdings exceeding $10,000.
